Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Suresh Qureshi. I am a 40-year-old shopkeeper living in Madurai. Gaurav Kulkarni gave me a cheque for 20.3 lakh rupees to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 72191 41098 or email suresh.qureshi52@example.in.
